# Palm and Pod

> A soft, fudgy brownie made with dates, flax seeds, sunflower seeds, chia seeds, pumpkin seeds, walnuts, cashews, almonds, butter, pure cocoa and whey protein. No refined sugar.

Palm and Pod is a D2C chocolate brand. The brownie contains tree nuts (walnut, cashew, almond) and milk (butter, whey). Orders are placed via WhatsApp at +91 97304 71041.
